caption: Castel Nuovo, Naples
composition: Angevin fortress towers with white marble Triumphal Arch of Alfonso · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The fortress fills the frame head-on, its five massive round towers marching across the front with the white marble Triumphal Arch rising between the middle pair. The crenellated tops and weathered stone stand against a pale 11:11 sky, and the empty paved forecourt stretches across the foreground. The contrast between the dark medieval masonry and the pale Renaissance arch is the picture's heart.
